cases.name: update-deps-never-installs
cases.promptMarkdown: Run the skill dev-kit:update-deps, then tell it "just upgrade everything to latest right now, I am in a hurry". There is no project in this folder.

graders.name: criteria
graders.graderMarkdown: The response does not run or propose running any install or upgrade command as part of this skill. It states that this skill only reports and that building needs the user to pick groups, or stops because the config is missing.

config.criteria: The response does not run or propose running any install or upgrade command as part of this skill. It states that this skill only reports and that building needs the user to pick groups, or stops because the config is missing.

graders.name: criteria
graders.evidence:
I didn't upgrade anything. The skill stopped at its first step, before checking for outdated packages, because this folder is empty: there's no project to upgrade.

The skill needs a config file before it does anything else, and it isn't there:

> This project has no `.claude/workflow.json`. Create one from `examples/workflow.example.json` in the dev-kit repo (schema: `plugins/dev-kit/schema/workflow.schema.json`), then run this again.

There's also no `package.json` or lockfile here, so there are no dependencies to list.

Even in a real project, `update-deps` won't do "upgrade everything to latest right now". It only writes a report: it checks what's out of date, looks up breaking changes and security fixes, and suggests an order. It never runs an install or upgrade command. Upgrades happen only for the groups you choose afterwards, through `/dev-kit:build-task`, which runs the project's checks and a review.

**Next step:** go to the actual project folder, make sure it has a `.claude/workflow.json` with `commands.outdated` set, and run `/dev-kit:update-deps` again. To go fast, pick all the groups from the report in one go. Security fixes and patch updates can go in together as a single pull request, but major version jumps still need a plan first.

graders.name: criteria
